feedback_text: The VAPT team delivered an exceptional penetration testing report. Critical flaws were identified before our production launch.
SafeX cloud architects secured our AWS infrastructure with outstanding professionalism and deep compliance knowledge.
The assessment was standard. The findings were adequate, but the final executive summary lacked detailed remediation guidance.
Disastrous experience. The automated rules failed to catch simulated brute-force attacks and communication was completely unresponsive.
Superb engagement! The team demonstrated real-world lateral movement and provided practical mitigations for our domain controllers.
The API test was completed on schedule. No major critical issues were found, but delivery met the baseline SLA terms.
Unacceptable quality. The static analysis report was full of false positives and the analyst showed lack of understanding in modern framework security.
Impressive social engineering simulation. Our security team learned valuable operational insights from the exercise.
Consulting met expectations. Standard templates were provided as agreed upon in the statement of work.
Extremely disappointed. Incident response team arrived late during a mock breach exercise and lost critical forensic logs.
Solid work on our web portal. Identified a severe IDOR flaw that could have led to severe data leakage.
The threat modeling workshop was informative and gave our software engineers clear guidelines for secure coding.
Hardware firmware testing went as expected. Delivered report according to standard protocols without any surprises.
Outstanding assessment of our iOS and Android banking applications. High-level technical expertise was on full display.
Very poor customer service. Delayed the final re-test verification report by over two weeks with zero proactive updates.
The phishing simulation campaign provided actionable insights and significantly improved employee security awareness.
Routine assessment completed. Some findings on IAM roles were useful, but overall matched generic benchmark benchmarks.
Excellent recommendations for database encryption at rest and SQL audit logging. Very satisfied with the outcome.
Critical industrial control systems testing was carried out safely with zero downtime. Highly recommended.
Average response times during alert triage. Neither particularly fast nor excessively delayed.
Frustrated by the constant rescheduling of auditor review meetings. Project deadlines were completely derailed.
Identified critical SQL injection and stored XSS vulnerabilities. Clear proof-of-concept steps made developer patching seamless.
Thorough code auditing of our clinical trial portal. Great attention to cryptographic implementations.
Network scan was conducted smoothly. Follow-up consultation answered our infrastructure team's questions effectively.
The red team exercise was average. Objective targets were partially achieved without deep persistence testing.
Phenomenal crisis management support. When an active ransomware probe was detected, SafeX contained the threat rapidly.
Terrible communication. The security analyst was rude during the debrief call and refused to explain vulnerability impact.
Fantastic test coverage across GraphQL and REST endpoints. Outstanding automated and manual testing balance.
Generic threat report that felt copy-pasted from internet boilerplates. Did not address our specific custom architecture.
World-class service from beginning to end. Accurate triage, zero false alarms, and executive-ready reporting.
